import hashlib,json,sys
from datetime import UTC,datetime
from pathlib import Path
from memfw.core.repository import Repository
from memfw.curation.engine import enforce_budget
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
sequence=iter(range(1,10000))
repo=Repository(root,clock=lambda: datetime(2026,10,18,tzinfo=UTC),id_factory=lambda:f"control-event-{next(sequence):05d}")
repo.init()
for index in range(20):
    repo.add(f"memory {index:02d}",f"small body {index:02d}",memory_id=f"control-{index:02d}")
config=repo.read_config()
config.update(budget_mode="total",max_count=10,max_bytes=1000000,forget_policy="fifo",forget_action="hard",budget_scope="all",log_keep_recent=5)
repo.configure(config)
result=enforce_budget(repo)
repo.compact_log(keep_recent=5)
files={path.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()}
print(json.dumps({"module":str(Path(__import__("memfw.curation.engine",fromlist=["x"]).__file__).resolve()),"remaining_ids":sorted(document.id for document in repo.list()),"applied_ids":list(result.applied_ids),"satisfied":result.satisfied_after_apply,"files":files},sort_keys=True))
